info.title: OpenBox local API
info.description: Public HTTP surface of the local OpenBox server (/api/v2). Native-host calls live under /api/host and are not documented here. Errors are application/problem+json (RFC 9457 shape).

error.description: Duplicates detail for one major cycle.

Problem.description: An error. Body is an RFC 9457-shaped problem document.
